text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio brilliantly succeeded in surpassing
her goal, Symboli Rudolf.

And so, the 'first three years'—a major milestone—
passed in the best possible way.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If you had to sum up these past three years in one word,
what would it be?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's obviously a "challenge"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Becoming number one among my peers, challenging the Triple Crown... so much happened, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because above all else,
I ran to surpass the President!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Is the most memorable event
still the Arima Kinen, after all?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Guess so!
It really was the race where I seized my dream, after all!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, your impression has changed quite a bit
since your victory at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Me?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
People are saying you've gained a sense of dignity and matured.
How do you feel about that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I feel so important! Heh-heh, behold, I am Teio!
(Hahahaha!!)

Having achieved such great accomplishments, those around her
seem to view her as having "grown."

"...However, after being passionately implored by her,
the place the two of us arrived at was—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoo-hoo!! An amusement park~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Which one should we ride?! The roller coaster?
The pirate ship? All of them, of course!
choice_data_list: Glad to see you having fun.
I'm glad to see you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you just thought 'she's such a kid,'
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, everyone's been
acknowledging how much I've grown, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And yet Trainer's the only one who didn't notice.
You still have a long way to go~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, never mind that, let's hurry up!
We're gonna run out of time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Total conquest of all the rides~!
An amusement park is a piece of cake for me!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, thanks for today!
I'm so glad you brought me along!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely! They're the best, after all,
especially the really fast ones!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...And you know, thank you not just for today,
but for everything up until now!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...For becoming my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: At first, I thought it didn't matter who my Trainer was since I was the one running, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Running alongside you for three years made me realize.
You're the only Trainer for me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So, really, truly, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Waaah~! You know who I am!?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yep! An Emperor who surpassed the Kaiser!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"When I grow up, I'm gonna run in races!
And then, I'm gonna beat Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you said it now~! In that case, I'll be waiting!
We definitely have to run together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah! See ya~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: See ya! Bye-bye!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, I'm really looking forward to it.
choice_data_list: Now you're the one everyone's aiming to beat.
Now you're the one everyone's aiming to beat.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I just feel so incredibly happy and excited,
it makes me want to start running right now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Prez felt like this too
when I told her she was my goal.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta keep working hard,
so I can run together with her!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, not just her... I'm gonna become someone even more
Umamusume can look up to!
choice_data_list: You've certainly grown into someone admirable.
You've certainly grown into someone admirable.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahem!
Did Trainer finally figure it out?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So with that said, I'm gonna keep on rocking it out there, so let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, this marks the opening of
Teio's Legend: Chapter 2~!!
